en.title: NNs for XOR-Logic Prediction
en.summary: Small neural net demo for logical gates with lightweight visualization.
en.challenge: XOR is not linearly separable, so it is a compact way to demonstrate why a single perceptron fails and how hidden layers learn nonlinear decision boundaries.
contribution: Implemented and compared simple neural-network structures for logic prediction.
Visualized training behavior and predictions in a small reproducible demonstration.
Documented the experiment as a public learning repository.
technical: NumPy represents inputs, weights, activations, loss, and parameter updates.
A hidden layer introduces nonlinear features required to separate XOR classes.
Plots and predictions make training behavior inspectable rather than presenting only final accuracy.

architecture.label: Inputs
architecture.detail: Binary pairs and expected XOR labels form the training set.

architecture.label: Model
architecture.detail: A multilayer perceptron applies weighted transforms and nonlinear activations.

architecture.label: Learning
architecture.detail: Loss gradients update network parameters over repeated epochs.

architecture.label: Evidence
architecture.detail: Predictions and visualizations show whether the learned boundary solves XOR.

outcomes: Demonstrates the practical difference between linear and nonlinear models.
Provides a concise public artifact for core neural-network understanding.
Shows the ability to explain model behavior with visual evidence.

zh.title: XOR 邏輯預測神經網路
zh.summary: 以輕量視覺化展示邏輯閘的神經網路示範。
zh.challenge: XOR 無法線性分離，因此很適合簡潔展示單層感知器為何失效，以及隱藏層如何學習非線性決策邊界。
contribution: 實作並比較用於邏輯預測的簡易神經網路結構。
在小型且可重現的展示中，視覺化訓練行為與預測結果。
將實驗記錄為公開的學習儲存庫。
technical: NumPy 表達輸入、權重、激活函數、損失與參數更新。
隱藏層引入分離 XOR 類別所需的非線性特徵。
圖表與預測讓訓練行為可被檢視，而非只呈現最終準確率。

architecture.label: 輸入
architecture.detail: 二元數值組合與預期 XOR 標籤構成訓練資料集。

architecture.label: 模型
architecture.detail: 多層感知器套用加權轉換與非線性激活函數。

architecture.label: 學習
architecture.detail: 損失梯度在多個訓練週期中更新網路參數。

architecture.label: 證據
architecture.detail: 預測與視覺化呈現學得的邊界是否能解決 XOR。

outcomes: 展示線性與非線性模型在實務上的差異。
提供簡潔的公開成果，呈現對神經網路核心概念的理解。
展現以視覺證據說明模型行為的能力。
